page.overview:
What is Force scattering?

Force scattering was a power that allowed a Jedi to imprint his presence in the Force across a specific area, making it very difficult for another Jedi to discern his exact location. Kueller used this to scatter his presence across a town before confronting Luke Skywalker on Pydyr.
